mods.doc: melonDS replaces no textures and loads no LayeredFS, so it has no mod kind; its cheats need [Instance0] EnableCheats and a .mch file per ROM (EmuInstance.cpp:836-852), a later kind.

doc.launch: The bundled source-built melonDS Qt frontend receives --fullscreen followed by exactly one positional Nintendo DS ROM. No host executable, Flatpak, libretro core, or prebuilt binary is permitted.
doc.state: melonDS reads $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/melonDS/melonDS.toml; the managed save, savestate and cheat paths point into its isolated state root.
doc.input: SDL raw joystick zero is the Steam Virtual Gamepad lane. The profile maps every DS control explicitly; pinned Qt actions consume Ctrl+S and Ctrl+A for slot-1 save/load, while Semu's process-group watcher owns Ctrl+Q and immediate physical Select+Start termination.
doc.rendering: The managed TOML pins both melonDS OpenGL selectors. The flake applies no Semu render hook, so no Semu bezel or shader reaches this emulator yet.
doc.content: melonDS 906e9ebb opens NDS and DSi ROMs (src/frontend/qt_sdl/Window.cpp:88) and, through libarchive (required by its CMakeLists.txt:87, ARCHIVE_SUPPORT_ENABLED), the ROM inside an archive (Window.cpp:117-130 lists .zip, .7z, .rar, .tar and compressed tars; the two ES-DE offers are declared).

save_states.doc: Semu saves and loads melonDS slot 1 (Shift+F1 and F1, profile.json native_shortcuts); there is no slot to choose.

menu.doc: melonDS has no Semu compositor on any platform (no render_hook, render_preload or render_vulkan), so the supervisor never opens the Semu menu there: it would be invisible.
